execution.scope: Validated mixed-mechanism operational inputs. Local addresses and equal-ranked route alternatives include every before/after observation; changed address epochs are retained explicitly and do not assert atomic simultaneity. Network invariant and positive Lean executions remain under construction. Bridge filtering/queues are safety overapproximations; the source inventories exclude redirects and transformations.

interpretations.meaning: Ordinary Red hosts map to other while retaining their declared host role. The workstation constructor is reserved for administrative-workstation obligations.

Inner and Outer devices are transit encryption gateways, supported by their declared roles, interfaces and forwarding enabled in both phases. The field does not assert independent hardware; other component kinds retain false in this view.
Declared laboratory label in classification; empty other dimensions are the single-label model interpretation, not recovered classification markings.
Declared veth zones, observed loopback, and inherited MACsec-lower/bridge-member attachment zones. A logical MACsec interface can hold the pre-encryption frame in its lower link's zone.
Observed veth endpoint in this emulation; no claim of independent physical hardware.
Static installed SCI/key peer bindings for the model endpoint inventory; no MKA exchange, CAK establishment or authentication history.

Distinct ordinal for each connected Red network, independent of its security-level label. The original execution export retains its earlier single-label domain values; hostNetworkIdBindings supplies the separate endpoint-network interpretation.
